report_name: House Democrats Seek GAO Probe into CISA Workforce Reductions

identities.name: U.S. House Homeland Security Committee
identities.description: The U.S. congressional committee whose Democratic members formally requested a GAO investigation into CISA's workforce reductions.

identities.name: Government Accountability Office (GAO)
identities.description: The U.S. government agency tasked by House Democrats to investigate the effects of substantial workforce reductions at CISA.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
identities.description: The U.S. federal agency subject to a requested GAO investigation due to significant workforce reductions under the Trump administration, which have reportedly impacted its mission readiness.

identities.name: Bennie Thompson
identities.description: Ranking member of the U.S. House Homeland Security Committee who led the request for the GAO investigation into CISA.

identities.name: State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial Governments
identities.description: Government partners whose engagement with CISA has reportedly been reduced due to the agency's workforce cuts.
